title: QDC Quantum Enchanter
description: Easily Add, Remove and Upgrade Enchantments on an Enchantable Item.
body:
This mod allows the user to Add, Remove and Upgrade Enchantments on enchantable items.

It requires QDC CORE 4.5 as a Core Mod, since it depends on the enchantments discovered by the Core Mod Disassembly and Discovery mechanic.

To add or upgrade an enchantment to/on an Item, Enchanted Particles from the Core Mod are required.
